name: Tres Leches Cake
desc: A light sponge cake soaked in three milks and topped with whipped cream and cinnamon.

source.title: Tres Leches Cake
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (5 separated eggs, 1 cup flour, 1/3 cup milk, 12 oz evaporated, 14 oz condensed, 1/4 cup milk, 1 pint cream with 3 tbsp powdered sugar) and the same step wording.

ingredients.raw: 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar, divided (3/4 cup + 1/4 cup)
1 pint (2 cups) cold heavy whipping cream
1 cup sliced fresh strawberries, for serving (optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Have an ungreased 9x13-inch baking pan ready.
In a medium bowl, combine the flour, baking powder and salt. Separate the eggs into two other mixing bowls.
Add 3/4 cup sugar to the yolks and beat on high until pale yellow, about 2 minutes. Stir in the 1/3 cup milk and the vanilla. Pour over the flour mixture and stir gently only until combined.

Beat the egg whites on high. As they start to hold peaks, gradually add the remaining 1/4 cup sugar and beat to stiff peaks. Gently fold the whites into the batter, scraping the bottom and sides, until no white streaks remain.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan. Bake 25-35 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Cool completely, about 1 hour.
Whisk the evaporated milk, condensed milk and 1/4 cup whole milk together. Poke holes all over the cooled cake with a fork.
Pour the milk mixture slowly over the cake, especially near the edges. Refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight, to soak.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla to stiff peaks. Spread over the cake, dust with cinnamon, and serve with strawberries if you like.
tips: It is better made a day ahead so the cake soaks up all the milk. Keep covered in the refrigerator 3 to 5 days.
